Kashmiri Pandit Employees Demand Secure Accommodation, Threaten Hunger Strike

Kashmiri Pandit employees appointed under the Prime Minister's Package protested in Srinagar, demanding the allocation of transit accommodation by September 30. They warned of an indefinite hunger strike if their demand is not met. Thousands of flats are reportedly ready. The employees seek secure housing, citing safety concerns.
